title: ElytraDurabilityGuard
description: Blocks elytra gliding when durability is too low.
body:
# ElytraDurabilityGuard

Blocks elytra gliding when durability is too low.

## Features
- Stops gliding under a durability threshold.
- Prevents accidental elytra breaks.
- Configurable percent threshold.
- Lightweight toggle hook.

## Command
- `/elytradurability status | /elytradurability reload`

## Permissions
- `elytradurabilityguard.use`
- `elytradurabilityguard.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
min-percent: 0.1
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4

## Install
1. Drop the jar into `plugins/`.
2. Restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` and run the reload command.
